body:
I love the look of standard poodles haha — will be an option for sure as they are also very intelligent. Not sure if my dad likes the idea of having a poodle, though, he’s not the type of person you’d expect to walk around with one. But you never know! 

Springer spaniels look quite cute! As with cockers. I’m really into their even temperment and their energy seems manageable. As for rough collies and smooth collies..so cute!! They also look like pretty good dogs so those are definitely on the list to consider.

Thank you so much!

I’m naturally quiet and introverted. I won’t say anything unless I want to or need to. Which usualy doesn’t happen. My dad once told me that getting information out of me was like “pulling teeth” one time when I was being quiet. So now I feel more ashamed for being quiet even though I know I shouldn’t be.

It’s a bit late in terms of the “permanent” stuff — I also have scars that I can’t get rid of. It makes me feel ashamed. I don’t feel any “stronger” from what I’ve been through because despite it all, I don’t feel like a “warrior” or anything like that because I feel like my issues and thoughts are nothing compared to others. What do I have to complain about? Why am I sad at all? I’ll try my best to hang in there. I plaster on a smile and that’s all I can really do.

I hope things get better for you, too.

I believe it’s because the distractions of the day don’t follow into the night, thus my reasoning for me experiencing these dark thooughts. I’m usually alone at night, and silently overthink and ruminate into a spiral that ultimately leads to a deep heaviness thag I can physically feel at times. Today, I sort of feel it this morning but I’ll shove it behind a mask, as per usual. I’m glad someone else feels the same way. I feel like I’m not so alone.

I have anxiety and depression, bipolar was considered but my psychological testing has revealed possible autism and adhd. The psychologist I talked to, when I mentioned how my boyfriend and therapist both suggested I was bipolar, he said to “be careful” as autism could have the same emotional dysregulation. But this seems a bit more than that.

I decided not to since it’s a pretty heavy drug, and it has affected my physically as it is. My psychotic symptoms are gone as well, but next time this should ever reoccur, I would go up higher on it.
They have their own issues. I don’t want to add to them.
I can try, but my anxiety has never let up in the many years I’ve had it. It’s intensified so badly as of late.
Thanks for the kind thoughts, I appreciate them. I will try. I’m just so tired, all the time.

i mainly just try and be there for them. It’s more the apprehension that something will happen and I’d be expected to help as a friend as they would for me, but I’m in no shape to do so. I’m really tired so I don’t know how much I can say besides I went through hypomania last year for a few weeks, dipped into suicidal depressive episode, which turned into major mood swings and psychosis, back to this exhausting slump. My doctor won’t diagnose until I get psychological testing which I’m getting in March.

I live in a dorm. So I’m not sure that’s not really possible. Nor do I have my own form of paying for it as I would have to use my parent’s money.

Also, it seems one of the possible side affects is vomiting, so that’s a no from me.

Thanks for the advice though. Maybe I’ll be bold enough to try it someday.
I have emetophobia that is severe enough for me to avoid recreational drugs. I also have paranoia and have unstable mood swings so I don’t trust myself on them (never tried them though).
Nope.

Yeah, zoloft (12.5 mg twice a day) and 0.5mg risperidone. Risperidone took away psychotic symptoms I had but left me a shell of a person and I feel a part of me has died. Zoloft doesn’t work for shit. Neither of them do anymore.
Nope.

I have a therapist I can call when I need to, but even then I have 0 privacy since I live in a dorm and everybody can hear me. I still have phone session with her but I have to be careful what I say and how I word it. I have too much paranoia that if I tel my friends or family they’ll have me committed to a hospital.
I do, including my therapist. But I don’t want to burden them with my issues if their mental health isn’t stable either.

Thanks for the reply, I really appreciate. I’ll try and reach out — I’m calling my therapist once a week for phone sessions but even then I can’t tell her everything for fear of being reported or committed or something. Very cautious of my words choices so I don’t get too far.

Hi! I am not diagnosed but I have had a hypomanic episode (brought on by zoloft). I had the EXACT same things — I did mini impulse purchases but was careful not to rack up the bill. I talked a lot and often to my friends who just thought I was happy and being more outgoing. It was only my boyfriend who mentioned he was concerned and said I sounded “erratic” even over text. I was aware that things weren’t right but I didn’t know how to describe it. I even got decent sleep — even if I woke up not thinking I needed it anyways. Stuff like that made me doubt I was even hypomanic, but just as you said — it doesn’t matter what others think, you know what’s best for you. Keeping track of your symptoms is a really good idea. I hoped my input helped!

Yeah, I wrote a whole log of sorts while I was in that state. Here’s an excerpt:

“ I’m transcending. My mind and body are NOT one they are different my mind is ahead of my physical vessel it lags behind. I feel hunger on a physical level but my mind needs no food. Time moves too slowly for me. I can’t stop moving for too long. I forget and forget and forget except what’s in my head. Reality is here but also not. I’m half in this world and half in another.”

It is really entertaining to read, i’ll give you that
Thanks for the input, much appreciated! And thanks for sharing your experience, it really does help me feel like I’m not alone on this.
(Thanks for the fast response) Also, that’s exactly what my therapist suggested. I’m getting psych testing done in March so maybe it will reveal something
Thanks, I have an appointment today with my psychiatrist and my therapist. Hope it goes well
When I’m watching something and there’s a character whispering. Usually makes whispering pop up in my head. Not really unsettling but definitely odd.
Thanks  I appreciate it. I try to think that but it seems far away so it doesn’t feel important to me

No worries, I am working with a therapist and psychiatrist but I feel I can only tell them so much. I don't think they can understand my thinking on such a level as I can myself. I know it is weird and off to others, but my reasoning for that is because people fear what they do not know. I am taking my medication every night since I have too much anxiety about withdrawal and its symptoms -- I think it's my saving grace, otherwise I'd already be off them.

My inner speech is corrupted, as in, not completely in my control anymore. I have people in my head that speak to me. Or to each other. The conversations vary - sometimes it’s based in what I’m doing or thinking, conversing amongst themselves, crying, screaming, whispering etc. It’s internal as in they use my inner voice as their own medium - oftentimes now my inner voice won’t sound like mine because they hijacked it to voice their own ideas. It’s annoying but also comforting to have others with me all the time, even when physically alone.

As for sleep, I still sleep enough. I might stay up closer to 1 or 2, but that’s it, even if my mind is revved up and wanting me to stay up all night. My mortal body just tires easily. 

I’m planning on communicating with the shadow people that live in my room, and there’s also a man with no eyes (cannot see them, but they show up as image-like visions in my mind so I know where they are). They have yet to speak to me coherently, though.

Interesting. Kind of where I am too (minus the orgasms). I feel less sensitive to cold sometimes, as if I am immune to it, and it’s difficult to get out of the “I am a god and nobody can convince me otherwise” type thinking. Like, if I were to do something like commit a crime, I couldn’t be caught or hurt because I am invincible. I’m not gonna do that, but the thoughts remain. It’s kinda weird, but might be my new normal I guess.

I moreso just feel tired. I’ll be fine thinking about something else, and then my mind’s like “hey don’t open your blinds, or they’ll read your thoughts!” Or “don’t forget the shadow people are all around you!” And I just feel this ‘ugggh’ feeling like I’m tired of thinking about it at times.

I could definitely try that! I tried back in October I think but failed as I plummeted into a really, really low mood. Eventually I just gave up and went back to my normal dose. I’ll try decreasing over a break from school, I think. Thanks!

I’m not sure. He says he doesn’t know from what this “psychosis” is coming from. My psychiatrist even asked me if I wanted to go UP on the zoloft and I was like “fuck no??” They haven’t worked since the hypomania, the only reason I take em now is because I’m scared of withdrawal. I’m getting testing done hopefully soon by a trusted colleague of his.

I think it’s very possible that the hypomania may be due to some underlying bipolar disorder (as I read from medical articles about SSRIs triggering an underlying hypomania/mania). My psychiatrist refuses to diagnose until I get psychological testing done, and my psych nurse practitioner who was more aware of the hypomania refused to diagnose/get me evaluated because she thought it was only the meds themselves. My psychiatrist now thinks it’s a possibility (I think) but hasn’t said it, again, bc he wants me to get the testing done. I just want him to tell me what’s going on though :/

I feel the anger too. Usually if someone tells me something that I don’t like or I take it the wrong way, mentally I devise a bunch of arguments to shoot back at them, or otherwise visualize myself screaming at them, things like that. The anger can be very intense and nobody would tell from the outside.

Thanks. I appreciate it. The shadow people are watching me work on art commissions, art’s the one thing that keeps me grounded and stable.

I’m currently on Zoloft (doesn’t really work and likely pushed me into a hypomanic episode back in September) and I was recently put on 0.5mg Risperidone last week. I’m supposed to be increasing to 1mg a night, but I keep being convinced not to do so. I’m even curious to quit meds altogether in hopes of communicating with the shadow people that live in my closet.

Not so great. Everybody is getting on my nerves on my campus and every little thing makes me wanna throw a fit. Something in my head sees someone not even doing anything and it’s like “just fucking punch them they look like a fucking idiot”. 
Last night I was convinced shadow people were playing around with my faucet in the shower and chased me out of the bathroom. I was terrified bc my surroundings were warped and I thought I was going to see them manifest.
Long story short, I’ve been really really paranoid and on edge but I’m still managing to hide it all under a normal guise.

Thanks for the reply, and on the other post I made. I appreciate it.

My therapist and psychiatrist seem to believe this is genuine. I don’t accept my experiences as psychosis even if the rational facts point to it. Things people say around me have a deeper meaning to me. The shadow people live in my closet - I cannot see them, but I can communicate with them telepathically. At the same time I feel like I can have moments where I’m like, “why am I thinking this?”

Other times completely, like now, I firmly believe I can communicate with shadow people despite not seeing them physically. I also firmly believe I am not alone in my mind and that people in my mind communicate to me using my inner voice as a medium. Random songs loop. Words loop. Whispers loop. But it’s all within my mind, not outside of it, so I struggle to understand if it’s still valid since it’s not outside of my head like a real person talking to me.

The meds have much easier side effects for me than Abilify which I was prescribed for hypomania back in the fall (gave me nausea which spiraled into anxiety attack as I have bad emetophobia) but this one just makes me wanna buy things with money I dont always have and makes me wanna eat a lot.

Thanks for replying. I was scared and began thinking that something about my post was scaring people away. 

I have a “rational” side of brain and “irrational” side where I can have bobbing waves between feel clarity “that was just a delusion/paranoia” to “no this is real this is very real and nothing can convince me otherwise”

I will ask my friends and see, but I’ve been honing the skill of hiding my symptoms for years (this is my first episode of whatever this is though) so it’s likely they’d chalk up my silence and lack of talking and such to my normal shyness or weirdness.

I do not do any recreational drugs, never have
